name: Kashi GO Original Crunch Cereal (Extreme Fiber WARNING)
whyItWorks: Delivers an astounding 13g of fiber per cup, loaded with chicory root inulin fiber, hard roasted seven-whole-grain clusters, and dense soy protein crisps. The rock-hard clusters resist chewing, posing a serious blockage risk against strictures while inulin triggers intense gas spasms.
prepOrOrderInstructions: STRICTLY AVOID. One of the highest-fiber cereals in the grocery store; guaranteed flare trigger.
